tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description:
Search Neruva's business identities (and any other bookable businesses). All filters optional.
    query: words that must all match, e.g. "penetration testing ohio"; category: e.g. "Cybersecurity",
    "Managed IT services", "B2B marketing agency"; locality: a city or state.

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description:
The full Neruva identity: every fact with its state, source page, date and who asserted it,
    plus claim status, verifications and the actions available (empty for unclaimed businesses).

tools.name: check_consultation_times
tools.description:
Open consultation times for a claimed business with booking on. start/end: ISO 8601 with
    offset, at most 14 days apart; default the next 7 days. Times are offers, not holds.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description:
Book a consultation time returned by check_consultation_times, straight into the business's
    calendar. Only after the person said yes to this business and time; set customer_confirmed=true.
    answers: the business's questions mapped to the person's answers.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Read a business's booking page: services with ids, prices, hours rules and how to book. Read this first.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List a business's services (id, name, duration, price basis, bookable or quote only).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description:
Open times for a service. start and end are ISO 8601 with UTC offset, at most 14 days apart,
    e.g. start="2026-10-01T00:00:00-04:00", end="2026-10-03T00:00:00-04:00". Times are offers, not holds.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description:
Send a quote request to the business. Only after the customer has confirmed the details;
    set customer_confirmed=true to say so. Needs an email or phone so the business can reply.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description:
Book a time returned by check_availability. Only after the customer has said yes to this exact
    business, service and time; set customer_confirmed=true to say so. Returns confirmed, pending
    (the business will confirm) or failed, with a reference.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description:
Cancel a booking made earlier. customer_contact is the email or phone used for the booking.
    Only after the customer has clearly said they want to cancel; set customer_confirmed=true to say so.
    To reschedule: check_availability, confirm the new time with the customer, book_appointment, then c

tools.name: check_request_status
tools.description:
Has the business confirmed, declined or replied? reference is the one returned by
    request_quote or book_appointment; customer_contact is the customer's email or phone.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_request_status · Public sink: request_quote, cancel_booking, check_request_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_request_status · Public sink: request_quote, cancel_booking, check_request_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
